name: Maltitols
aliases: E965, E965i, E965ii, maltitol, maltitol syrup, jarabe de maltitol, maltitoles
what_is: A low-calorie polyol sugar alcohol obtained by hydrogenation of D-maltose.
why_botia: Maltitol sweetens almost like sugar and behaves similarly in baking, which is why it is found in most sugar-free chocolates and sweets. It is only partly absorbed — the rest reaches the large intestine, which is where the gas or laxative effect comes from. JECFA did not see a need to set a numerical limit.
can_1: Detect E965 and map it to sweetener and E-number layers.
can_2: Explain its partial absorption and the digestive effects that can occur at higher intakes.
cannot_1: Measure the exact percentage of maltitol added.
cannot_2: Predict whether a particular intake will cause digestive symptoms in an individual.

sources.label: Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 — E965 in the Union list — consolidated 18 August 2026
